description.zh:
修改后的主机连接地址的类型。取值：

- **Public**：公网
- **Private**：私网
description.en:
The new portal type of the host. Valid values:

- **Public**: public portal

- **Private**: internal portal

description.zh:
要修改连接地址类型的主机ID。该参数为JSON格式的字符串，最多可输入100个主机ID。
您可以调用[ListHosts](~~200665~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the host for which you want to change the portal type. The value is a JSON string. You can add up to 100 host IDs.

> You can call the [ListHosts](~~200665~~) operation to query the ID of the host.

description.zh:
要修改连接地址类型的主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host for which you want to change the portal type of the host.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

description.zh:
要修改连接地址类型的主机所在堡垒机的区域ID。

> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host for which you want to change the portal type of the host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 修改运维主机时使用的连接地址类型

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-hosts-active-address-type --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-ids 1_,_2 --active-address-type Private --region cn-hangzhou
